## Standing operator rules
Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Investigate `BillingWorker.process_batch()` retention across successive batches; the reconciliation-job goal is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 broke the Stripe client. Popping events before persistence caused retry-retention failure.

## Recent work
Moved `pending_events.pop()` below `record_usage_event()`; focused retry test passed and retained two events after simulated failure. A breakpoint showed pending lengths of 0 after batch one and 3 after batch two. Currency tests and full suite passed; lint was clean.
